independent-components.def: In two-dimensional motion, the horizontal and vertical components each follow their own one-dimensional rules; what happens in one direction does not affect the other. Only the time is shared.

projectile.def: An object that, after launch, moves under gravity alone (air resistance negligible): zero horizontal acceleration and a constant downward acceleration g.

launch-angle.def: The angle between a projectile's initial velocity and the horizontal. It sets how the launch speed splits: horizontal v cos θ, vertical v sin θ.

horizontal-range.def: The horizontal distance a projectile travels before landing: the horizontal velocity times the time of flight.

time-of-flight.def: How long a projectile is in the air. It is set by the vertical motion alone: the vertical launch velocity, the height and g.
